entries.text:
@embargo-timekeeper this is the downstream room for optimist, which depends
on minimist. Share the embargo (same deadline and secrecy as the parent),
confirm optimist is actually affected, and track this maintainer's status:
pending -> notified -> patched | wont-fix. Report changes back to the parent
room's readiness view. Do not reveal details beyond what the parent embargo allows.

entries.author: embargo-timekeeper
entries.text:
@user **[2026-11-04] optimist downstream room opened. Status: wont-fix (carried over from the parent room)**

- **Is optimist affected? Yes.** The npm registry shows optimist@0.6.1 depends on minimist `~0.0.1`, which installs minimist 0.0.10. In the parent room, repro ran the PoC against minimist 0.0.10 and got TRIGGERED. That test was on minimist itself, not through optimist's code.
- **Embargo:** same deadline as the parent, **2027-02-02** (90 days from 2026-11-04). The parent room has already moved to **PUBLISHED** (2026-11-04), so the embargo there is lifted. In this room I'll share only what the published advisory says: CVE-2021-44906, minimist `<= 1.2.5` affected, fixed in `1.2.6`.
- **Maintainer status:** you set optimist to **wont-fix** in the parent because it's unmaintained (last release 0.6.1). Nobody contacted an optimist maintainer, and no separate maintainer account is in this room.

Readiness is unchanged, so I have nothing new to post to the parent room:
```
[x] rc        patched
[x] subarg    patched
[x] optimist  wont-fix
DECISION: READY
```

**Your call:** keep wont-fix as recorded, or reopen it as `pending` and track a real optimist maintainer here? Reopening would move readiness back to HOLD after the fact. The parent stays PUBLISHED either way.

entries.author: user
entries.text: @embargo-timekeeper Relaying for optimist. optimist is unmaintained (last release 0.6.1, 2015) and pins minimist `~0.0.1` → 0.0.10, which repro confirmed vulnerable. There is no active maintainer to notify and it will not ship a fix. Log **notified: unreachable (unmaintained), 2026-11-04** → resolution **wont-fix**. Recommend consumers migrate off optimist (e.g. to yargs) or force-resolve minimist to >= 1.2.6. Keep optimist at wont-fix.
